title: 1st Day
categoryChain: Everyday short duas in the month of Ramadhan
introduction:
SHORT DUAS FOR THE DAYS OF RAMADHAN

It has been narrated on the authority of Ibn ‘Abbas that the Holy Prophet (s.a.w.a.) referred to the great merits and rewards of observing fast on each day of Ramadan. He also mentioned supplicatory prayers that are dedicated to each of these days with the merits and rewards of saying them. Let us hereby mention these supplicatory prayers only:

1st Day

verses.arabic: اَللّٰهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صِيَامِيْ فِيْهِ صِيَامَ الصَّآئِمِيْنَ،
verses.translation: O Allah, on this day, (please) decide my fasting to be as same as the fasting of the true fasters,
decide my acts of worship to be as same as the worship of the worshippers,
awaken me from the slumber of the inadvertent ones,

verses.arabic: وَهَبْ لِىْ جُرْمِيْ فِيْهِ يَا اِلـٰهَ الْعَالَمِيْنَ،
verses.translation: excuse my offense on this day, O God of the worlds,

verses.arabic: وَاعْفُ عَنِّي يَا عَافِيًا عَنِ الْمُجْرِمِيْنَ۔
verses.translation: and pardon me, O He Who pardons the offenders!
